description: Gateway Distriparks Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated inter-modal logistics services in India. The company offers general and bonded warehousing, rail and road transportation, first- and last-mile connectivity, and container handling services, as well as other value-added services, such as palletization and sheet wrapping. It also provides temperature-controlled warehousing, transportation, distribution, and supply chain solutions services. In addition, the company owns and operates rail rakes and a fleet of trailers. It serves food, pharmaceuticals, e-commerce, dairy, seafood, and other temperature-sensitive industries. The company was formerly known as GatewayRail Freight Limited. Gateway Distriparks Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in New Delhi, India.
